description: This file defines the PduParser class, which is responsible for parsing MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) PDUs (Protocol Data Units). It includes methods for parsing headers, parts, and content types of MMS messages, interpreting various header fields and encoding schemes as per the WSP (Wireless Session Protocol) specifications.

classes.name: PduParser
classes.description: Main class for parsing MMS PDUs from byte streams, extracting headers, parts, and interpreting encoding schemes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method that initiates parsing the PDU data stream into a corresponding GenericPdu object based on message type.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses the headers of the PDU from the input byte stream and stores them in a PduHeaders object.

methods.name: parseParts
methods.description: Parses the message parts (attachments or embedded objects) within the PDU.

methods.name: parseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header and its parameters from the input stream.

methods.name: parsePartHeaders
methods.description: Parses headers specific to each part in multipart messages.

methods.name: parseWapString
methods.description: Parses WAP formatted strings, handling quoted strings and text strings.

methods.name: parseEncodedStringValue
methods.description: Parses encoded string values, including character set information.

methods.name: parseLongInteger
methods.description: Parses long integer values encoded according to WSP specifications.

methods.name: parseShortInteger
methods.description: Parses short integer values, typically used for header fields.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Utility method for logging debug information if the local verbose flag is enabled.

methods.name: checkPartPosition
methods.description: Checks the position of a specified part, identifying if it's the first or last within the message.

methods.name: checkMandatoryHeader
methods.description: Validates the presence of all mandatory headers for a specific message type in the PDU.
